title: Vanta X4 Inspection Drone
subtitle: Interactive exploded view · concept demo

parts.name: Top shell
parts.description: Weather-sealed graphite cover. Protects the electronics from rain and dust and carries the status markings.

parts.name: Carbon core frame
parts.description: Carbon-fiber chassis. Every arm, battery and sensor bolts to this stiff, lightweight backbone.

parts.name: Flight controller
parts.description: The drone's brain. Reads the motion sensors hundreds of times per second and adjusts each motor to keep the drone stable.

parts.name: Left battery
parts.description: Hot-swappable lithium-ion pack. Two packs let the pilot replace one at a time without powering down.

parts.name: Right battery
parts.description: Second hot-swappable pack. Each pack shows its charge on four green lights.

parts.name: GPS / RTK module
parts.description: Satellite positioning puck on a mast, raised above the electronics for a clean signal. RTK correction gives centimetre-level accuracy.

parts.name: Obstacle sensors
parts.description: Stereo cameras that see obstacles ahead so the drone can brake or steer around them automatically.

parts.name: Transmission antennas
parts.description: Folding antennas for the video and control link back to the pilot's controller.

parts.name: Gimbal camera
parts.description: Stabilised camera on a 3-axis gimbal with zoom, wide and thermal lenses for inspection work.

parts.name: Landing gear
parts.description: Carbon skids that keep the camera clear of the ground on take-off and landing.

parts.name: Arm (front right)
parts.description: Folding carbon arm. Folds in for transport and locks out for flight.

parts.name: Arm (front left)
parts.description: Folding carbon arm. Folds in for transport and locks out for flight.

parts.name: Arm (rear right)
parts.description: Folding carbon arm. Folds in for transport and locks out for flight.

parts.name: Arm (rear left)
parts.description: Folding carbon arm. Folds in for transport and locks out for flight.

parts.name: Motor + propeller (front right)
parts.description: Brushless motor spinning a 21-inch folding propeller. Two props spin clockwise and two counter-clockwise so the drone doesn't twist.

parts.name: Motor + propeller (front left)
parts.description: Brushless motor spinning a 21-inch folding propeller. Two props spin clockwise and two counter-clockwise so the drone doesn't twist.

parts.name: Motor + propeller (rear right)
parts.description: Brushless motor spinning a 21-inch folding propeller. Two props spin clockwise and two counter-clockwise so the drone doesn't twist.

parts.name: Motor + propeller (rear left)
parts.description: Brushless motor spinning a 21-inch folding propeller. Two props spin clockwise and two counter-clockwise so the drone doesn't twist.

note: Vanta X4 is a fictional concept drone made for this demo. Its specs are illustrative, based on typical industrial inspection drones of this size. Not affiliated with any drone maker.
